limits: Native and legacy observations are disjoint; unavailable whole native owners are not passing numerical comparisons.
Legacy full-file parse, selected physical source indices and transitions are observed precomputation, not a live cursor or mutable daily weather owner.
Native input-line boundaries are external hashed-input identities only; no private native record-index or selected-day range is inferred.
An end-environment cursor may be rewound to the header; this report never uses a final cursor as the last selected day.
Processed native timestep buffers, raw EPW values, physical projection, interpolation, solar and sky formulas remain unpaired.
Source provenance checks preserved actual build/source archives and recorded before-after guards; no fresh whole-workspace or compiler-selection certification.
